question: Why did Grocery Black Friday Live hit its GMV and audience targets but miss conversion and go over budget?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, c.start_date, c.planned_operating_cost, c.actual_operating_cost, SUM(m.gmv) AS gmv, AVG(m.conversion_rate) AS conversion_rate, MAX(m.peak_concurrent_viewers) AS peak_concurrent_viewers FROM campaigns c JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = c.department_id JOIN campaign_metrics m ON m.campaign_id = c.campaign_id WHERE d.name = 'Fresh Grocery' AND c.name = 'Grocery Black Friday Live' AND c.start_date = DATE '2025-11-12' GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.name, c.start_date, c.planned_operating_cost, c.actual_operating_cost
reply: The campaign generated $181,057 GMV and 16,069 summed daily audience, but conversion averaged just 8.84% and swung from 1.12% to 14.42%; weak click-through on some products and high returns on others may have limited conversion. It spent $34,027 against a $28,867 plan—$5,161 (about 17.9%) over budget—but the available records don’t break down expenses, so they can’t show what drove the overrun.

queries.sql:
WITH target_campaign AS (
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.name, c.planned_operating_cost, c.actual_operating_cost
  FROM campaigns c
  JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = c.department_id
  WHERE d.name = 'Fresh Grocery'
    AND c.name = 'Grocery Black Friday Live'
),
metric_summary AS (
  SELECT m.campaign_id,
         SUM(m.gmv) AS total_gmv,
         SUM(m.dau) AS summed_daily_audience,
         AVG(m.conversion_rate) AS avg_conversion_rate,
         AVG(m.watch_time) AS avg_watch_time,
         AVG(m.avg_dwell_time_minutes) AS avg_dwell_time,
         jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('date', m.date, 'gmv', m.gmv, 'dau', m.dau,
                    'conversion_rate', m.conversion_rate,
                    'peak_concurrent_viewers', m.peak_concurrent_viewers)
                   ORDER BY m.date) AS daily_metrics
  FROM campaign_metrics m
  JOIN target_campaign c ON c.campaign_id = m.campaign_id
  GROUP BY m.campaign_id
),
product_summary AS (
  SELECT p.campaign_id,
         SUM(p.sales_amount) AS product_sales,
         SUM(p.units_sold) AS units_sold,
         AVG(p.click_through_rate) AS avg_click_through_rate,
         AVG(p.sell_through_rate) AS avg_sell_through_rate,
         AVG(p.return_rate) AS avg_return_rate,

         jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('product', p.product_name, 'units_sold', p.units_sold,

                   ORDER BY p.sales_amount DESC) AS products
  FROM campaign_products p
  JOIN target_campaign c ON c.campaign_id = p.campaign_id
  GROUP BY p.campaign_id
),

  SELECT b.campaign_id,
         COUNT(*) AS behavior_records,
         AVG(b.dwell_time_minutes) AS avg_customer_dwell_minutes,
         AVG(b.purchase_amount) AS avg_purchase_amount,

  FROM campaign_customer_behavior b
  JOIN target_campaign c ON c.campaign_id = b.campaign_id
  GROUP BY b.campaign_id
)
SELECT c.name, c.planned_operating_cost, c.actual_operating_cost,
       c.actual_operating_cost - c.planned_operating_cost AS cost_over_plan,
       ms.total_gmv, ms.summed_daily_audience, ms.avg_conversion_rate,
       ms.avg_watch_time, ms.avg_dwell_time, ms.daily_metrics,
       ps.product_sales, ps.units_sold, ps.avg_click_through_rate,

FROM target_campaign c
